opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
By way of these application, the applicant seeks for regularization of the period of late surrender of 38 days when the applicant had been released on parole leave in the month of November 2022.
2. Considering the jail remarks, it appears that the applicant, who has been convicted for 15 different offences and has to undergo incarceration of 23 years 6 months and 15 days and whereas it would appear that the applicant has already undergone a total incarceration of approximately 15 years and insofar as the present case is concerned, the applicant has undergone incarceration of 9 years and 8 months.
It would also appear that the applicant has intermittently surrendered late/absconded and whereas as far as the present case of abscondment of the applicant is concerned, according to the case of the applicant, since someone was trying to usurp the possession of the land in which the applicant and his family are staying, therefore, the applicant could not surrender in time.
opennyai_summary.decision:
Considering the fact that the applicant has been convicted for 15 different offences, more particularly offences punishable under Sections 406 and 420 of IPC and whereas further considering that the maximum sentence imposed upon the applicant appears to be of 23 years and further considering that the applicant has already undergone approximately 15 years of incarceration, this Court is inclined to consider the present application.
4 . Hence, the period of late surrender of 38 days is hereby directed to be regularized.
The application is disposed of as allowed.
Rule is made absolute accordingly.
